fullText.simplified:
错别字

    有一天，周明要出门去约一个朋友。出门之前，他想告诉下人需要注意什么，就写了一张纸，放在桌上。短短的几句话，里面却有三个错别字：“丢脸”写成了“去脸”，“经过”写成了“经边”，“事情”写成了“事请”。
    温姬看到了这张纸，心里又生气又失望。她翻过这张纸，在后面写了一句：“去脸是什么？经边这个事请我真是明白了。和你这样的男人在一起，我还不如回去做歌女。”
    她把这张纸给周明，对他说：“开始的时候，我想，你是大户人家的孩子，你家里的人都很有才华，你也是个读书人，所以我不怕羞，不怕别人笑我，主动来找你。想不到的是，你只有读书人的外表，没有一点儿才华。”
    温姬越想越伤心，越想越觉得失望。她又说：“如果你认真读书，那么简单的字，你一定不会写错的。但是你每天都只想着玩，不想读书。我只是看中了你的外貌，大家知道了，全都要笑话我温姬呢！”
    这句话说完，温姬摇了摇头，一下子就不见了。
    周明听了温姬的指责，真是太羞愧、太后悔了。都怪自己没有多看书，没有好好学习，一想到温姬就这样离开，他的心就空空的。
    等回到那个熟悉的房间，这里再也没有一点儿温姬的影子了。那个笑容满面陪着他的温姬就这样离开了。周明伤心极了，他仔细地看了看温姬写的字，还是不明白哪儿有问题。他只好把那张纸拿给下人看，请下人告诉他温姬写了什么。
    下人虽然帮他说清楚了，但也觉得这件事太可笑了。一个大户人家的孩子，读书多年的男人，却叫女鬼也看不上他。这件事很快就传了出去，成了所有人都知道的一个笑话。

后记：
    在一千多年前的中国，这样的“温姬”可以算是一个奇女子。她虽然是女子，却比男人更爱读书。她敢爱敢恨，看到喜欢的男生，自己去表白；不喜欢的时候，就马上离开。
    本来是一个非常美好的故事，可惜周明这个生在大户人家的公子哥，家里一代一代都是读书人，自己却没有一点儿才华。让温姬一个女鬼都后悔和他在一起，觉得与其和他在一起，不如回去做歌女。周明的父母想了那么多办法赶走女鬼，全都没有效果。等她一看到周明的错别字，马上失望摇头，自己就离开了。
    人们觉得，蒲松龄写这篇小说，是用来讽刺那些大户人家的公子哥，只有外表，没有才华。周明写的那些错别字，比黄纸、佛经都厉害，真的可以吓走女鬼！
fullText.traditional:
錯別字

    有一天，周明要出門去約一個朋友。出門之前，他想告訴下人需要注意什麼，就寫了一張紙，放在桌上。短短的幾句話，裡面卻有三個錯別字：“丟臉”寫成了“去臉”，“經過”寫成了“經邊”，“事情”寫成了“事請”。
    溫姬看到了這張紙，心裡又生氣又失望。她翻過這張紙，在後面寫了一句：“去臉是什麼？經邊這個事請我真是明白了。和你這樣的男人在一起，我還不如回去做歌女。”
    她把這張紙給周明，對他說：“開始的時候，我想，你是大戶人家的孩子，你家裡的人都很有才華，你也是個讀書人，所以我不怕羞，不怕別人笑我，主動來找你。想不到的是，你只有讀書人的外表，沒有一點兒才華。”
    溫姬越想越傷心，越想越覺得失望。她又說：“如果你認真讀書，那麼簡單的字，你一定不會寫錯的。但是你每天都只想著玩，不想讀書。我只是看中了你的外貌，大家知道了，全都要笑話我溫姬呢！”
    這句話說完，溫姬搖了搖頭，一下子就不見了。
    周明聽了溫姬的指責，真是太羞愧、太後悔了。都怪自己沒有多看書，沒有好好學習，一想到溫姬就這樣離開，他的心就空空的。
    等回到那個熟悉的房間，這裡再也沒有一點兒溫姬的影子了。那個笑容滿面陪著他的溫姬就這樣離開了。周明傷心極了，他仔細地看了看溫姬寫的字，還是不明白哪兒有問題。他只好把那張紙拿給下人看，請下人告訴他溫姬寫了什麼。
    下人雖然幫他說清楚了，但也覺得這件事太可笑了。一個大戶人家的孩子，讀書多年的男人，卻叫女鬼也看不上他。這件事很快就傳了出去，成了所有人都知道的一個笑話。

後記：
    在一千多年前的中國，這樣的“溫姬”可以算是一個奇女子。她雖然是女子，卻比男人更愛讀書。她敢愛敢恨，看到喜歡的男生，自己去表白；不喜歡的時候，就馬上離開。
    本來是一個非常美好的故事，可惜周明這個生在大戶人家的公子哥，家裡一代一代都是讀書人，自己卻沒有一點兒才華。讓溫姬一個女鬼都後悔和他在一起，覺得與其和他在一起，不如回去做歌女。周明的父母想了那麼多辦法趕走女鬼，全都沒有效果。等她一看到周明的錯別字，馬上失望搖頭，自己就離開了。
    人們覺得，蒲松齡寫這篇小說，是用來諷刺那些大戶人家的公子哥，只有外表，沒有才華。周明寫的那些錯別字，比黃紙、佛經都厲害，真的可以嚇走女鬼！

sentences.simplified: 觉得与其和他在一起，不如回去做歌女。
sentences.traditional: 覺得與其和他在一起，不如回去做歌女。
sentences.pinyin: jué de yǔ qí hé tā zài yì qǐ bù rú huí qù zuò gē nǚ
sentences.english: .. and felt that instead of being with him, it was better to go back to being a performer.

sentences.simplified: 周明的父母想了那么多办法赶走女鬼，全都没有效果。
sentences.traditional: 周明的父母想了那麼多辦法趕走女鬼，全都沒有效果。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng de fù mǔ xiǎng le nà me duō bàn fǎ gǎn zǒu nǚ guǐ quán dōu méi yǒu xiào guǒ
sentences.english: Zhou Ming’s parents tried so many ways to drive away the female ghost, but none of them worked.

sentences.simplified: 等她一看到周明的错别字，
sentences.traditional: 等她一看到周明的錯別字，
sentences.pinyin: děng tā yí kàn dào zhōu míng de cuò bié zì
sentences.english: When she saw Zhou Ming’s incorrectly written characters, ..

sentences.simplified: 马上失望摇头，自己就离开了。
sentences.traditional: 馬上失望搖頭，自己就離開了。
sentences.pinyin: mǎ shàng shī wàng yáo tóu zì jǐ jiù lí kāi le
sentences.english: .. she immediately shook her head in disappointment and left by herself.

sentences.simplified: 人们觉得，蒲松龄写这篇小说，是用来讽刺那些大户人家的公子哥，
sentences.traditional: 人們覺得，蒲松齡寫這篇小說，是用來諷刺那些大戶人家的公子哥，
sentences.pinyin: rén men jué de pú sōng líng xiě zhè piān xiǎo shuō shì yòng lái fěng cì nà xiē dà hù rén jiā de gōng zǐ gē
sentences.english: People think that Pu Songling wrote this novel to satirize the pampered sons of those noble families, ..

sentences.simplified: 只有外表，没有才华。
sentences.traditional: 只有外表，沒有才華。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu wài biǎo méi yǒu cái huá
sentences.english: .. who only had good appearances, but no talent.

sentences.simplified: 周明写的那些错别字，比黄纸、佛经都厉害，
sentences.traditional: 周明寫的那些錯別字，比黃紙、佛經都厲害，
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng xiě de nà xiē cuò bié zì bǐ huáng zhǐ fó jīng dōu lì hai
sentences.english: Those incorrectly written characters by Zhou Ming were more powerful than yellow paper and Buddhist scriptures.

sentences.simplified: 真的可以吓走女鬼！
sentences.traditional: 真的可以嚇走女鬼！
sentences.pinyin: zhēn de kě yǐ xià zǒu nǚ guǐ
sentences.english: They could really scare away female ghosts!

sentence_translations: Incorrectly Written Characters
One day, Zhou Ming was going out to meet with a friend.
Before going out, he wanted to tell his servants some things to pay attention to, ..
.. so he wrote a note and put it on the table.
In a few short sentences, there were three incorrectly written characters: “丢脸” [To lose face] was written as “去脸”, ..
.. “经过” [through] was written as “经边”, and 事情 [matter] was written as “事请”.
When Wen Ji saw this note, she felt angry and disappointed. She turned over the note and wrote on the back:
“What is ‘去脸’? I’ve really come to understand something through this. [written using incorrect characters]
With a man like you, I might as well go back to being a performer.”
She gave this note to Zhou Ming and said to him, “At first, I thought that since you are a child of a noble family, ..
.. and everyone in your family is very talented, then you would also be a scholar.
So I wasn’t shy and wasn’t afraid of people laughing at me, and I took the initiative to come to you.
I didn’t expect that you would only have the appearance of a scholar and don’t have any talent at all.”
The more Wen Ji thought about it, the sadder she became.
The more she thought about it, the more disappointed she became.
She also said, “If you studied hard, you wouldn’t write such simple characters incorrectly.
But you just want to play around every day and not read books.
I just took a fancy to your appearance. When everyone finds out, they will all laugh at me, Wen Ji!”
After saying this, Wen Ji shook her head and suddenly disappeared.
After hearing Wen Ji’s criticism, Zhou Ming was very ashamed and regretful.
He blamed himself for not reading more and not studying hard.
His heart was empty when he thought of Wen Ji leaving like this.
When he returned to the familiar room, there was no longer any trace of Wen Ji there.
The smiling Wen Ji who accompanied him had left just like that.
Zhou Ming was very sad. He carefully looked at Wen Ji’s writing, but still didn’t understand what was wrong.
He had to show the note to a servant, and ask the servant to tell him what Wen Ji had written.
Although the servant clearly explained it to him, the servant also thought this was too ridiculous.
A child of a noble family, a man who’d been studying for many years, yet he made a female ghost disdain him.
The incident spread quickly and became a joke to everyone.
Epilogue:
More than a thousand years ago in China, a woman such a “Wen Ji” would be regarded as a strange woman.
Although she was a woman, she loved to read more than men.
She dared to love and hate, and when she saw a guy she liked, she confessed her feelings.
When she didn’t like him anymore, she left immediately.
It is a very beautiful story at first. It’s just a pity that Zhou Ming was the pampered son of a noble family
The family had been scholars from generation to generation, yet he had no talent at all.
Wen Ji, a female ghost, regretted being with him, ..
.. and felt that instead of being with him, it was better to go back to being a performer.
Zhou Ming’s parents tried so many ways to drive away the female ghost, but none of them worked.
When she saw Zhou Ming’s incorrectly written characters, ..
.. she immediately shook her head in disappointment and left by herself.
People think that Pu Songling wrote this novel to satirize the pampered sons of those noble families, ..
.. who only had good appearances, but no talent.
Those incorrectly written characters by Zhou Ming were more powerful than yellow paper and Buddhist scriptures.
They could really scare away female ghosts!
